messages:
Clara: Quick ask — for next week's webinar can we build a compact 'bench casebook' that shows latency vs cost for three micro-slices (ecom search, conversational assistant, batch embeddings)? Need 1 slide per slice + a 1-line takeaway and a chart with x=latency (ms), y=$/1k tokens. Want to emphasize routing + quantization tradeoffs. Thoughts?
Tom: Love it. For charts: scatter with model variants as points, arrow showing throughput tradeoffs. Show p50 and p95 callouts. Use log scale on cost.
Leah: Add a small customer quote for each slice if possible, e.g., 'cut inference cost by 3x while keeping p95 < 300ms' — I'll ping CS.
Ravi: Routing note — show fallback path: hosted -> dedicated -> private and cost/latency ranges for each. Call out autoscale burst behavior.
Maya: Demo idea — 30s console clip: change batching 1->8 and show token/sec + $/1k change in real time. Quick, punchy.
Ken: CTA — 'Try the benchmark with your workload' + quick-start template link. Also capture webinar registrants in a follow-up form to self-identify use case for inbound routing.
Clara: Ok assign: Tom = slide charts, Maya = demo clip, Leah pls get quotes, Ravi write routing blurbs, Ken write CTA + form. Can we aim for first draft by EOD Tuesday? :rocket:
Leah: Pinged CS in the thread (cc @Jules) — will ask for 2–3 blurbs.
Jules: I can pull two case snippets from recent deployments, will drop them by Mon.
Tom: Tentative axis labels: x = median latency (ms), color = deployment mode, size = throughput (req/s). Quick plot snippet:
```python
plt.xscale('log')
plt.xlabel('p50 latency (ms)')
plt.ylabel('$ per 1k tokens')
```
Maya: I'll record console walk and render mp4 @30s.
Clara: Also draft two one-liner headline options for the slide deck: 1) 'Same quality. Lower cost. Faster scale.' 2) 'Optimize for latency, save on budget.' Pick fave.
Ken: Prefer #1. I'll draft landing copy and short social post variants.
Ravi: Tiny ask — include an eval footnote: prompt set, token length assumptions, model temp. e.g., baseline = 10-200 token prompts, 128 gen tokens.
Clara: Good call. We'll add a small footnote and a link to the benchmark repo/colab in the slide notes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
